name: Luminous Flash
prerequisites: firefly sprite heritage or Darklands Light
text:
Requirements Your natural light is kindled.

---
You release all the light within your body in a dazzling burst. Each creature in a 15-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Then, your natural light is extinguished, and you can't rekindle it again for 1 hour.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Dazzled until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature is Blinded until the start of your next turn and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can spend an Interact action rubbing its eyes to end the blinded condition.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 minute and dazzled for 1 hour.
